thesis: Short-term momentum is negative below SMA-20/50, while price remains above SMA-200; expansion headlines are not quantified and financials lack period dates.
strongest_counterexample: The strongest counterexample is stabilization above SMA-200 with expansion/payment initiatives contributing to earnings, which is not yet measured.
invalidation_conditions: A close below the observed 60-bar low would weaken the longer-term stabilization case.
evidence_gaps: Financial statements and P/E earnings basis lack period dates.
Mandate and payments revenue/credit effects are not supplied.
